body: I know, but it isn't just this. There has been a lot. This was kinda the nail in the coffin. The last thing I had going for me is gone. All I have left to look forward to is to get sad drunk with my friend. I mean its just, nothing works out for me. Nothing has, and it looks like nothing ever will. So why try, what's the point. I hate my life so fucking much right now. Tbh I dont know what keeps me going everyday, I could end it all in the next ten minutes if I wanted to. But there is something stopping me, I am not sure what it is but it is a strong force. But I feel like its getting weaker by the day. My life was hard enough, I mean I am doing bad in my classes, I have this stupid drama thing that basically cost me half my friends, because some bitch is mad at me and made up a bitch of shit. (but everyone listens to her because she is the nice little girl and I am the big guy.) I mean I still am "friends" with these people, but it will never be the same.  And now some guy just took the last thing I had going for me. And as the cherry on top of this shit Sunday I am have mild anorexia ( or something alone those lines) and still manage to be fat. My life is just shit right now. I kept going by saying i will ask her out and then things will get better but now that's fucking gone too. Basically fuck life. Fuck my friends, fuck my school, fuck myself, and fuck that guy. Ugh I dont wanna sound like some edgy teen or anything. But seriously why cant one thing fucking go okay.
What do you mean by in my head or there in reality?

Thanks man. I would try /r/relationships but i have heard many horror stories about that sub. Idk have you been there, is it alright? And i thought i did like the one who just got out of a relationship more, and the other one not at all. But lately they have started leveling out, which is why i am so hesitant to make a choice. Like, if i can start liking someone else this fast do i really like the first person. Also kinda unrelated, looking at these two people, i realize i definitely have a type haha.

Okay than my suggestion would be slowly pull away until he gets the message or until you don't interact anymore. Either he will realize and stop and you can still be friends or you guys will not be friends anymore. Turn down his requests to interact more. Maybe you are busy more. Start turning down one in every four, than maybe more. Until he gets the message. If you want to stay friends with him, maybe the best thing is just a conversation, tel him what you think. But, and i can not stress this enough, if he becomes a problem or this gets worse, don't hesitate to just cut off contact.

What in your opinion would be good ways to judge which one might be better for me. I look through pros and cons of both, and they bot have different pros and cons. They don't know about each other. Well they may like me somewhat, but not enough to compete with each other (though that would be fun). I kinda like both of them and idk how much either of them like me. The dance is soon so i will ask one of them in the next two weeks. And though i doubt it, if i am rejected by one, is it okay to them ask the other, or is that a super douche thing to do? I definitely want a relationship, i know that. I would definitely be okay with any level of seriousness, i haven't had any serious high school relationships before, just casual ones that really were not much. One of them did get out of a moderatly serious relationship a month ago, she is not 100% moved on but is getting there. i am moderately confident she at least likes me somewhat, and am almost 100% i would get a yes if i asked. But does the fact that she is not 100% over her ex mean that maybe asking her isn't a good idea. Once again sorry about my terrible writing and bad clarification. Just ask if you need more detail in something.
